decision.explanation: The question asks 'When was the Church of Our Lady of the Rosary built?' and the provided sources describe multiple distinct churches with the same name located in different places: Alcamo (Italy), Goa (India), Asmara (Eritrea), and San Bernardino (California). Each source provides a specific construction date for its respective church. These are distinct valid answers because the referents (different churches with the same name) are clearly identified in their contexts. There is no evidence of conflicting claims about a single referent, so all five dates remain valid.
